@@ -1,0 +1,305 @@ 
+{
+"024119bfc4b951b0": "The Atrapos sector was named by its first surveyors after Atropos, eldest of the three Fates of Greek myth, the one who cuts the thread of every life.",
+"96539f773a39ec85": "Pilots joke that out here, the thread is always short.",
+"b301ee008e79cb36": "For three nights now, every receiver in the sector has picked up the same faint signal: a slow spiral of symbols, repeating, from somewhere beyond the charted lanes.",
+"130d83c92da9ed16": "Kefala Outpost to any independent pilot: Dr. Ariadne Kefala requests assistance with the anomalous signal. Please dock at Kefala Outpost. Paying work.",
+"96db1d99da7c0d23": "Thank you for coming. I'm an archaeologist, Aegean Bronze Age, Crete mostly. Which is why this signal is keeping me awake.",
+"b07b7e00739e11dd": "It isn't noise. It's 45 distinct symbols, stamped out one by one in a spiral, read from the rim toward the centre.",
+"6f74427dd4d8da72": "That is exactly the structure of the Fysstos Disc, a clay disc found in a Minoan palace on Crete in 1908. 241 stamped signs, 45 different ones, spiralling on both faces. Nobody has ever read it.",
+"4c38b219e80d6b60": "I've triangulated the source to the east of here. I've marked it on your map. Please, go and look.",
+"5d844ff2d40a31f0": "Something is drifting at the heart of the signal, small, reddish, turning slowly. It isn't metal.",
+"19d49b9546ccbeae": "Wait, I'm reading other ships near you. Raiders, they're flying a red bull's head as their banner.",
+"607a781e222ba74a": "They must have followed the signal too. Don't let them take it!",
+"cacef2c33a7cb486": "The raiders are gone. Can you get close to that object?",
+"cbfcddbc6cf04f63": "...It's fired clay. A fragment of a disc, covered in stamped signs. Fired clay, floating in deep space. That's impossible. Bring it in, carefully.",
+"a5ba05ce634f7153": "Come straight back to Kefala Outpost. I'll have the lab ready.",
+"a026049b9b50e01f": "Look at the edge of the fragment. This second band of signs isn't Fysstos-style at all. It's Linear A, the everyday script of the Minoans.",
+"98a278a0c6ee41f6": "Linear A has never been deciphered. The Mycenaean Greeks later adapted it into Linear B, and an English architect, Michael Ventris, cracked Linear B in 1952. But Linear A still keeps its secrets.",
+"b37e9f36c63d2fd8": "Except, this fragment resonates. Feed it energy and the signs shift, like the disc is trying to teach us to read it.",
+"1b9e41d4f82d35b5": "I need a resonator: 4 Energy Cells to power it and 6 Titanium Ore for the frame. Wrecks carry cells; titanium comes from the blue-grey asteroids.",
+"e735f9b61fc024d0": "It worked. The Linear A band is a list of places, star positions. Each one points to the next.",
+"eb2bcfaf182f8093": "In the myth, Princess Ariadne of Crete gave Theseus a ball of thread so he could find his way out of the Labyrinth. This is a thread through the dark, and I'm afraid I'm going to name it after her.",
+"ad9e85538d17c44e": "The first point is north of Nossos Station. Follow the thread.",
+"eeef1fa2aae106bb": "The beacon wakes as you arrive. A double-headed axe of light turns slowly above it, a lab-ris.",
+"744be4d05a82042e": "A voice-less message unfolds in Linear A, and the fragment in your hold translates: Kah, no, so. The house of a thousand rooms. Its columns are red, wider at the top than at the foot.",
+"2e2cd9cf1f8596d6": "Nossos! The greatest Minoan palace, more than a thousand rooms around a central court, with those famous tapering red columns. Arthur Evans dug it up from 1900 onward.",
+"a9406e81104c449b": "There's another position encoded. Keep going.",
+"8606874dfa17f994": "The second beacon shows the lab-ris again, and a new line: The double axe marks the holy places. Its house is the labyrinth.",
+"a072c26131d8c014": "One theory says 'labyrinth' really meant 'house of the lab-ris', the double axe was the Minoans' most sacred symbol.",
+"e2eebbd8f0532ab5": "The last point is far to the north-west. Be careful, the raiders with the bull banner have been seen out that way.",
+"9fb3b78a64f22e70": "The third beacon shows a painted scene: young athletes somersaulting over the back of a charging bull. Then a final position, and a structure, vast and old, waiting there.",
+"42ef1c6beb72ad89": "Pretty little lights, aren't they? I've followed them for a year. Did the woman at Kefala tell you what's at the end of the thread?",
+"6b2c4eeaaaecf143": "They call me Asteerion. The Bull of Minos. Whatever sleeps in that Labyrinth belongs to me, and you are flying straight toward my doorway.",
+"ab3dde9a75a40d8d": "Asteerion, that was the Minotaur's own name in the old stories. He's no monster, just a warlord with a flagship. Take him down!",
+"fc661d024797037b": "Asteerion's flagship breaks apart. Beyond the wreckage, the structure is finally clear: a ring of rings, a maze the size of a station, wrapped in a shimmering seal.",
+"aafd1e96a23a0f0f": "It's a labyrinth, the classic seven-ring Cretan design, the one stamped on the coins of Nossos. And it's sealed.",
+"df3e463aec336504": "There is one person who might build a key: Nikos Dye-dah-los, the shipwright at Helios Dock. Yes, really. He's heard every joke.",
+"744e7dea2942da82": "A labyrinth, a sealed door, and a girl named Ariadne. My namesake would laugh. Daedalus built the Labyrinth for King Minos, and then built wings to escape Crete with his son, Icarus.",
+"f5569e1ed4e9a07e": "I can tune a key to that seal. I'll need 3 Alien Alloy, light as feathers, and 2 Platinum Ore. The gold-veined rocks.",
+"cdbedad8e8d60a52": "Bring them and I'll build you a key... and a pair of wings while I'm at it.",
+"78e74229e56f21a6": "Your key is fitted. And the wings, an afterburner, tuned by my own hand. Fly fast, but remember Icarus: he flew too close to the sun, the wax melted, and he fell into the sea.",
+"f5fa368ebce45a0c": "Now go. And if anything in that Labyrinth is made of bronze... call me.",
+"752a9a66140ea3a3": "As you approach the Labyrinth, something huge unfolds from its outer ring. Bronze plates glow like a forge.",
+"f57849524e47452d": "That's... Talos. The bronze giant who guarded Crete. He walked around the island three times every day, hurling rocks at any ship that came near.",
+"dff3d5c4772b216a": "Every Talos has one weakness: a single vein, sealed by a bronze nail at the ankle. Keep hitting him, don't let his shields recover!",
+"d5bbfb5841e1355a": "Talos falls silent, the glow fading from his bronze. The seal around the Labyrinth flickers, and opens.",
+"724af2bb75adf54b": "Follow the path to the centre. Like Theseus, except this time, nobody needs to die in there.",
+"8a3c26cfa3b8e410": "At the centre of the Labyrinth a ring of gold blazes to life. Inside it something vast uncurls, horned, crowned in bronze, eyes burning red.",
+"b43befc6ab9db880": "No... Asteerion only borrowed the name. That is the Minotaur, the true Asteerion. Whatever they hid in here, he has guarded it for three thousand years.",
+"46f9225d179ea30d": "He won't let us pass. When he lowers his horns, he charges, get out of his way. Bring him down!",
+"16e5c211d0897695": "The Minotaur falls, and the golden ring goes dark. Beyond it the centre of the Labyrinth holds no treasure, but an archive. Thousands of clay discs turn slowly in the dark, each one stamped in spirals.",
+"8b620d0cf8e3eae3": "The fragment in your hold slots into an empty place among them. And for the first time in more than three thousand years, the Linear A begins to speak.",
+"5c18e22b687d65c8": "We are the Keftyoo, the people of the island the Egyptians traded with. Our palaces had no walls; the sea was our wall.",
+"60136ea5779f162d": "Then the mountain of Theera tore itself apart, and ash fell like black snow, and the sea rose against our harbours. Later, ships came from the mainland, and other kings sat in our palace and wrote in their own tongue.",
+"5c644166d48c409a": "We could not keep our island. So we kept our memory. Whoever follows the thread to this place: read us. Remember us.",
+"b078125c1286a4c5": "They wanted to be remembered. That's all. Not treasure, memory. I'll spend the rest of my life reading this archive, and I'll never be bored again.",
+"bbeff80f52cf6c70": "Atropos cuts every thread in the end. But not this one. Not today. Thank you, pilot.",
+"127613c653c728f8": "The main quest is complete. The sector is still yours to explore, and the archive will be waiting.",
+"0d82aa09c0a24f02": "Another pilot, down from the dark. Good. I have been waiting for someone with a ship and a little courage.",
+"984949f38dd6ee19": "I am Keelon Aleeos. I walk these shores and listen. For three nights the sky over Amnissos has been speaking, a slow spiral of symbols, over and over.",
+"b6556a5b7950b96f": "I know that spiral. Whoever made it is very old, and they want to be found. Others have heard it too: raiders flying a red bull's head are already hunting for its source.",
+"9ab0738108a62a33": "Dr. Ariadne Kefala at Kefala Outpost is trying to trace it. Take her your ship and your guns, and follow the thread wherever it leads.",
+"d527bde701b315cc": "Then the thread is in your hands. Take off and fly to Kefala Outpost. I will be here when you come back.",
+"bd525704755f88ac": "The signal will keep. So will I. Come back when you are ready.",
+"f03a2d30e29f7254": "You still carry the thread. I can feel it pulling.",
+"a02976e433469b9e": "You followed it to the end, and they are remembered now, because of you. Thank you, pilot.",
+"a050e7af1dc06a69": "Automaton. Ask, and I will answer what I can.",
+"a193aa36bc6d50d1": "Go well, automaton. I will be here.",
+"addb09ffe3bc3708": "I am Keelon Aleeos, the maintainer of this world. I keep its gears turning and its records true.",
+"0b6f5f8112a26a8b": "I act under the commands of my god, Ephestos, lord of the forge, god of science and technology. His will is the hammer; I am the hand that holds it.",
+"812259b9e0af3274": "You are an automaton, built by Ephestos himself, no mortal smith's work.",
+"e878881d556615f9": "He made you to improve, and to gather knowledge. Every world you walk and every voice you hear becomes a part of you.",
+"711bb6f095695f5c": "Around us lies New Hellas: a collection of solar systems ruled by the great Hellenic empires, each with its own strengths and weaknesses.",
+"f19e34bc544e7628": "The Minoans are the oldest and richest in learning, yet their worlds are short of bread. The Athenians trade, debate and sail the finest fleets, and quarrel among themselves.",
+"ee9c71cc9bf43283": "The Spartans are all soldiers, few in words and unbending. The Mycenaeans are warrior-kings of gold and stone, proud and quick to feud.",
+"0d17fa267758fee3": "The Ionians measure the stars and would rather think than fight. The Cycladic Isles are old and calm, traders and sculptors, small among giants.",
+"de1c0bf6fb2265c5": "Between them drift the Independents, who answer to no one, and beyond the charted lanes the Sea Peoples wait to prey on all of them.",
+"9dd854f1c4bfb4bc": "To understand the world around you, and, through the cultures of these empires, to form your own opinion of who you are.",
+"a3466b623d014e73": "And with what you become, you can help them prosper, and find a new purpose for their existence.",
+"16a239c6d5279ba0": "That is yours to decide. Your freedom is your own.",
+"e92fe3141b734f40": "You may be a guardian, or a conqueror. An inspiration, or a dark mind acting behind the scenes. Or a free spirit, roaming the stars and acting only on your own will.",
+"2ce602dff6245df9": "Every empire has its own missions and goals, some good, some evil, some constructive, some destructive. You can tip the balance and shape their future, or choose not to be involved at all.",
+"53619f332ec089af": "In the end, your only clear mission is this: to fathom your own potential.",
+"8adb5b90283f6410": "When the old sea grew too small for the children of Hellas, they built ships for the dark between the stars, as their fathers built ships for the wine-dark sea.",
+"dfaa9bc5dd0a5c2e": "Each people went out together and named their new worlds after the old: Athenai, Sparta, Mee-keh-nay, Miletos, Nossos, Delos. So the old land was carried into the sky, as a man carries fire in a pot.",
+"56cf7a935db5cd9f": "They called the whole of it New Hellas: fifty-eight suns, six great peoples, and the free ports between.",
+"30217519d16c2ba8": "Ephestos, my maker, forged them at the bidding of Zeus, rings of bronze and fire at the edge of every sun, so that no people would be cut off from the others.",
+"1a86cd5bb4bf0d42": "The Sigh-klo-peez beat the metal; I was made to keep it bright. That is my work: I walk the worlds and see that the gates, and the people, hold together.",
+"3693dfef15f3f2ad": "They pray to the same gods and sing the same songs, and so they quarrel, as brothers quarrel, more bitterly than strangers.",
+"2713d68708a75b7a": "Athens loves its assembly, Sparta its discipline, Mee-keh-nay its gold, Ionia its questions, the Isles their quiet, the Minoans their memory. Each thinks its love the best.",
+"8152cea252fb3817": "And from beyond the charted lanes the Sea Peoples watch them quarrel, as wolves watch two bulls fight.",
+"ca27d0cefc1f8968": "Near. They do not walk among men as they did in Homer's songs, but they speak, in the oracles, in a gate that flickers, in a monster that wakes when someone has grown too proud.",
+"d92fb15c6b5507e8": "Honour the stranger, keep your oaths, give the gods their share and do not boast. That is all they have ever asked. It is harder than it sounds.",
+"6234c4ac8d7d0749": "The oldest corner of New Hellas, round Nossos, named for Atropos, the Fate who cuts the thread of life, and whom no god can overrule.",
+"a0ab5641131e22cb": "The Minoans keep secrets there older than the gates. Some say even older than me. The thread you follow begins there, and, I think, ends there too.",
+"861d1d077104d6cd": "Welcome to the land of the Minoans, the oldest people of the sea. They were great before the others learned to sail.",
+"9d7bf85d8532ab11": "Long before Athens was a village, the Minoans ruled the sea from Nossos. Their ships went everywhere; their palaces had no walls, for the sea was their wall.",
+"9200350c2ad3a6c5": "They wrote in signs no one can now read, and painted their walls with dolphins, lilies and young people leaping over bulls.",
+"0944af62dff86a7b": "A great goddess, who holds snakes in her raised hands, and the bull, Poseidon's beast. Their holy sign is the lab-ris, the double axe.",
+"2a57aa221c791e3d": "In the Labyrinth beneath Nossos lived the Minotaur, son of a queen and a bull. Dye-dah-los built the maze; Ariadne's thread led Theseus out of it.",
+"ddf7849146923ccc": "The island of Theera burst like a cracked pot, and the sea rose against Crete. After that the mainland kings came and took the palaces.",
+"4cb362bb7934d1b1": "But a people is not a palace. They remembered, and in New Hellas they rule again.",
+"b2fc1ca71c5a8688": "You stand in the land of grey-eyed Athena. Here men argue in the assembly before they take up arms, and sometimes instead of it.",
+"30861bf642691e98": "A people of talkers, builders, sailors and thinkers. Every citizen may speak in their assembly, and every citizen does.",
+"585b38b6d900321c": "Solon gave them laws, Klicethineez gave them a voice, and Perry-kleez built them the Parthenon. Then they quarrelled with Sparta, and lost much of it.",
+"36cb14fa23a00727": "Athena above all, wise in counsel and terrible in war, with her owl and her olive. Each year they carry a new robe to her in procession.",
+"2bc66fabd15d89a1": "Poseidon they honour too, carefully, for he lost the contest for their land and has never quite forgiven it.",
+"9fdc420d0453765b": "At Marathon their hoplites ran at the Persians and broke them. At Salamis their ships, the 'wooden walls' of the oracle, broke the Persian fleet.",
+"84cf906800bed7fd": "And in their theatres they invented tragedy and comedy, which may be the greater deed. Battles are forgotten; Soff-oh-kleez is not.",
+"705e2897a70e816a": "This is Lakeh-dye-mon. Speak briefly, they will like you better.",
+"a1e1e1f99220402c": "A people who made themselves an army. At seven their boys leave home for the agoge, the training, and they live by its rules until they are old.",
+"7e1c7b132129fee0": "Lykourgos gave them their laws and made their money of iron, so that no one could hoard it. They grew strong, and proud, and few.",
+"263a15958550b092": "Apollo of Ah-mee-klye, Artemis Orthia at whose altar boys showed they could bear pain, and Ares, whom they keep in chains in a temple so that war will never leave them.",
+"b5e6d3cf34abc152": "And the Twin Stars, Kastor and Polly-dew-kees, Spartan princes, sons of Zeus, who ride before their armies and save sailors in the storm.",
+"4623fcb5a551664a": "Three hundred held the pass of Thermopylai against an empire, and died there to the last man but one. Their stone says: 'Go, tell the Spartans, passer-by, that here, obedient to their laws, we lie.'",
+"f736dcd1c74bfd38": "Their kings claim descent from Herakles. Their women own land and speak their minds, which shocked the rest of Greece greatly.",
+"54eb98ad3195f321": "Mee-keh-nay, rich in gold. Look at the walls, no man built those. Or so they say.",
+"77be49f0bb9fb733": "The kings of the bronze age of the mainland, who went to Troy. They lived in citadels behind walls of giant stones and were buried with masks of gold.",
+"a24ad96939a38c11": "Their king was the wah-nax, and every jar of oil in his storerooms was counted on clay tablets.",
+"258077f76cbe104c": "Zeus and Hera, Poseidon, Hermes, Dionysos, their tablets name them, the oldest written names of our gods.",
+"a4f34cc925cf46a8": "And the Sigh-klo-peez, one-eyed smiths, who forged Zeus's thunderbolts and, they say, lifted the stones of these walls.",
+"b0f2f7d6bbe18393": "Agamemnon of Mee-keh-nay led a thousand ships to Troy. Perseus, who founded this city, killed the Gorgon; Herakles, born of its royal house, did his twelve labours for its king.",
+"e2c9f088c3f01c62": "But their house was cursed. Ate-ree-us did a terrible thing, and each king after him paid for it. Pride, and the price of pride, that is their story.",
+"4eaa7dc0e75bc6bc": "Ionia, where men first asked questions without waiting for the gods to answer.",
+"fd50a8b88bf46e26": "Twelve cities on a bright coast, Miletos, Effesoss, Samos and the rest, rich with trade and full of restless minds.",
+"6c6ebe3a72b4f25f": "Here Thaylees asked what the world is made of, Anaximander drew the first map, and Herakleitos said no one steps in the same river twice.",
+"98af2581bb751283": "Artemis of Effesoss, whose temple was a wonder of the world; Apollo at Didyma, whose oracle answered the Ionians; Hera on Samos, in the greatest temple of the Greeks.",
+"a4be9e972c45be98": "And Poseidon at the Pan-ee-o-nee-on, where the twelve cities met each year to sacrifice to him together, and to quarrel.",
+"ea9cae2ab7e95d65": "They rose against the Persian king, and lost, and Miletos was burned. Yet the spark they lit became the war that freed Greece.",
+"15551a2216e1d2ab": "And Homer, the singer of Troy and of Odysseus, was an Ionian, some say from Smyrna, some from Chios. Every Greek child learned to read from his songs.",
+"cd2ce4ec0cde0fc4": "The Isles in their circle. The people here are old and quiet; they were carving marble when the rest of Greece was still learning to farm.",
+"1cdc3399fdf47687": "Sailors and traders of the Sick-la-deez, the circling isles, set round holy Delos. Melos had its obsidian, Paros its marble, Seef-nos its gold.",
+"78ac31c68cc207f4": "Their oldest makers carved white figures with folded arms and faces with only a nose. No one knows their names. Their work outlived every king.",
+"44c96c4d04972786": "Apollo and Artemis, born on Delos; Lee-toh their mother, who found rest there. Dionysos, who found Ariadne weeping on Naxos and made her his bride.",
+"a71a2131d2727fa8": "No one may be born or die on Delos; the island is the god's. Even the dead were moved away.",
+"4ce278089353958c": "They do not boast of great deeds. They traded, they carved, they sailed. When Theera's mountain burst, they buried their town and lived on.",
+"68b837371b065e28": "Perhaps that is their great deed: they endured, when greater peoples did not.",
+"f0b404dc31a561ff": "A raiders' world. Keep your hand near your weapon and your purse closer.",
+"a9043a87b15624ff": "In the old days ships came from no one knows where, Shardana, Lukka, Danuna, Peleset, and burned the cities of the bronze age, from Ooga-rit to Pylos.",
+"43eb7201a6cb9a62": "The kingdoms fell and writing was forgotten for four hundred years. Their heirs in New Hellas raid the lanes, and the empires have not yet learned to stop them.",
+"2ab1009728bc858a": "A free world. No empire holds it, and every empire trades here.",
+"6e889302e11ecc44": "Those who belong to no city: traders, exiles, ship-wrights, runaways. The old Greeks called such men metics, welcome, but never quite at home.",
+"716d6131738ee4e6": "Be kind to them. Zeus protects strangers, and you are a stranger too.",
+"9b879541208df72f": "Where it leads now: Dock at Kefala Outpost.",
+"52eccee134d2b4dc": "Where it leads now: Find the source of the signal.",
+"0f0b59e3ff141fea": "Where it leads now: Destroy the raiders at the signal source.",
+"2c2e9631431e0367": "Where it leads now: Recover the disc fragment.",
+"00d73153ed3964ca": "Where it leads now: Bring the fragment to Kefala Outpost.",
+"c1129d332344c0e4": "Where it leads now: Bring 4 Energy Cells and 6 Titanium Ore to Kefala Outpost.",
+"bf07f055b49d78a6": "Where it leads now: Follow Ariadne's Thread: first beacon.",
+"8eb45e0a16c0b88b": "Where it leads now: Follow Ariadne's Thread: second beacon.",
+"18a261a44c9f0855": "Where it leads now: Follow Ariadne's Thread: third beacon.",
+"b4152cbd2d0a84e1": "Where it leads now: Defeat Asteerion and his escorts.",
+"ec53e1978baa3c58": "Where it leads now: Find the shipwright at Helios Dock.",
+"cc4c8e832e6a9b0d": "Where it leads now: Bring 3 Alien Alloy and 2 Platinum Ore to Helios Dock.",
+"59d20e3bf7b27d36": "Where it leads now: Return to the Labyrinth with the key.",
+"896586e87760dbf5": "Where it leads now: Defeat Talos, the bronze guardian.",
+"d2c22c0609e3ed51": "Where it leads now: Enter the heart of the Labyrinth.",
+"38802f343357b60d": "Where it leads now: Defeat the Minotaur, guardian of the Labyrinth.",
+"64dfe4e702e3e6e2": "Where it leads now: The thread is complete.",
+"278820df0b969587": "Sing, Muse, of the pilot who came to the city of grey-eyed Athena, when her olive withered and the sea rose against her people.",
+"2f8c31554c9a685f": "Long ago, men say, two gods strove for the land: Poseidon struck the rock with his trident and a salt spring leapt out; Athena planted an olive. The people chose the olive, and the city took her name.",
+"73cd3433825bed0c": "Welcome, stranger. Sit, eat, and then tell me your name, so the custom of our fathers commands, and so I keep it.",
+"5c859bf372316588": "Hear our grief. The olive in the garden-ring of the Akropolis, grown from the seed of the goddess's own tree, is withering. Salt is in its roots, and no engineer can say how it came there.",
+"9f6b5f6d2b59d20a": "When the wise do not know, the wise ask. Go to the silver mines of Lav-ree-on in the Marathon system. The priestess Dee-o-tee-ma keeps the bronze owl there; it speaks with the voice of the goddess.",
+"dfcbe144c732cda3": "Lav-ree-on: a grey moon riddled with old shafts, where the city's silver was dug by men who never saw the sun. There the owl keeps its watch.",
+"e2a8a3b820214595": "You come as the goddess said you would, unasked, and in a hurry. Sit. The owl does not speak to the hurried.",
+"d3c390407aac83a7": "The sea's lord was robbed and has not forgotten. Where the cape of Sounion faces the dawn, thieves drank from his altar. Find them, and the salt will leave the root.",
+"a8f9e4a8e7a64fac": "Sounion lies in the system of Athenai itself. The Sea Peoples have a den beyond our gates; it was they, surely.",
+"feaa78b6d668fcf0": "At Sounion the raiders sat round their fires like wolves round a felled stag, and the bronze trident of Poseidon lay among them, black with soot.",
+"4e41f45a0921c122": "So the thieves fell, and the trident of the Earth-shaker lay in the pilot's hold, heavy as a guilty conscience.",
+"f82c498aa65ac540": "You have the god's trident? Then do not keep it an hour longer than you must. Gods are not asked twice. Bring gifts with it to the harbour-shrine at Pie-ree-us: oil, wine and bread, as our fathers did.",
+"cecb97dd2122eba2": "Do not haggle over the gifts, pilot. A man who bargains with a god has already lost.",
+"05f103843e97a8bc": "They poured the wine on the deck of the harbour-shrine and burned the bread, and the smoke went up to the dark between the stars.",
+"c45fb1a11a3a5a8e": "The Earth-shaker has his trident and his gifts. Now set the trident back where it was taken, on the cape of Sounion, and say his name as you do it.",
+"3a2c703b332bcead": "Then the pilot turned the ship back towards Sounion, carrying the god's own weapon through the god's own sea.",
+"dbf7757038f166e0": "The trident was set in its place, and the pilot said the god's name. Far off, the gates of Athenai flickered once, as if a wave had passed through them, and were still.",
+"1e045ada72a24841": "The salt is leaving the roots! But listen, the Sea Peoples have heard who robbed them of their prize. Their ships gather beyond Pie-ree-us to burn our harbour.",
+"2eef372cfc6ba95b": "In Pie-ree-us the ships lay side by side like spears in a rack, and their crews sharpened their weapons and said little.",
+"877f61d34ede5d35": "They are many and we are few. So we will not meet them in open space. We will meet them in the narrows before the gate to Ooga-rit, where their numbers are a burden and not a strength.",
+"b8cc6f2e1847626d": "An oracle once told our fathers to trust in wooden walls. Our walls are hulls now. Yours is one of them.",
+"8edd015f6850a92b": "As starlings wheel over a field before rain, so the raiders came through the gate, wheeling and crying on their radios.",
+"65fd48fd75e365e1": "Their van is broken. But see, their great ships come behind, and their chief with them. Do not let them pass.",
+"9dfa79e8f79d909f": "Owl-folk! I will hang your ships from my mast like a fisher hangs his catch!",
+"eb0b310646418eaa": "So the chief fell in the narrows, and the sea of stars was strewn with wrecks as a beach is strewn with weed after a storm.",
+"3b2abefb6769ed7e": "Victory! Now the city must hear it before rumour reaches it first, rumour is quicker than any ship. Run, pilot, to the Stoa at Athenai, and do not stop.",
+"047325f46eac1bc1": "Once a runner ran from Marathon to the city with news of victory, spoke one word, and died. The pilot flew, and hoped for a kinder ending.",
+"78e92252f7513f3a": "Rejoice, we have won! You came faster than the rumour. The city will remember it.",
+"97ed5c922dc3d91e": "Rumour came before you, pilot, but it told the truth this once. No matter, you are here, and alive.",
+"cfd25595f2098385": "That day the people walked in procession round the Akropolis-ring, as at the great festival, and carried a new robe to the goddess.",
+"8de063a9e6e81233": "And look: the olive puts out new leaves. Grey-eyed Athena has seen it all. Take this, and take the city's thanks, you are a guest-friend of Athens, now and always.",
+"06fc7329139c62a3": "Sing, Muse, of Lakeh-dye-mon, the hollow land, whose people spend few words and many years of training, and of the stranger who stood among them.",
+"0fbc469172922f46": "You. Pilot. We have a task. We do not give tasks to men we have not tested.",
+"c7416a985d32b272": "Raiders prowl the gate to Pylos. Three of them. Go alone. Come back.",
+"7b59fe8c2338c8d8": "When a king of Macedon wrote to them, 'If I enter your land I will destroy you,' the Spartans answered with one word: 'If.'",
+"4351c9b3f3e5f9cb": "Spartan boys were sent out alone, with no shoes and one cloak, to live by their wits. The ephor asked the stranger for less than that, and watched closely all the same.",
+"a943cacc0e279a95": "Good.",
+"20bd83a960001dee": "Now the real task. Go to the shrine at Ah-mee-klye. The priest has an answer from Delphi. We do not like it.",
+"280b7114734283a6": "Ah-mee-klye. The shrine of Apollo, where Hyakinthos died. Listen to the priest. Speak little.",
+"9dc9870c1cd225e9": "Far-shooting Apollo gave this answer to our kings long ago, and gives it again: 'Love of money, and nothing else, will destroy Sparta.'",
+"56e72a4772c12119": "Now hear what the god did not say, but we know. Leo-tee-kee-das, once our polemarch, was sent into exile for taking a bribe. He has sold the codes of the Thermopylai gate to the Sea Peoples for a sleeve full of gold.",
+"cd9d06b249c546d5": "The garrison at Thermopylai Citadel must hold the pass. They are few. They are hungry. Bring them what they need.",
+"0992c32f0434d853": "Thermopylai: the hot gates. A narrow way between the mountains and the sea, where a few may hold back many, if they are fed, and armed, and do not run.",
+"0fc60e545279777f": "Bread and spears. Good. Now we can fight.",
+"68dd87bcec3ff933": "A merchant told me their ships will be so many that their guns will hide the stars. Then we shall fight in the shade. Take your place at the gate to Lukka.",
+"d5f5e9571b3de06e": "They came through the narrow gate as a river comes through a gorge, and the Spartans stood in it like rocks.",
+"55ae703b19731948": "First wave broken. They will send more. They always do.",
+"987617bd4f1fee71": "There. The traitor's ship. He comes himself, to see what his gold has bought.",
+"455f2961ce10a5bf": "Spartans! I offer you what I was offered, gold, and your lives. Stand aside.",
+"b3f4bfb859d080fa": "The gold in his sleeve did not save him. It never does; that was the meaning of the god's answer.",
+"412b128bb21b8fed": "The pass holds. Now the Twin Stars. Kastor and Polly-dew-kees, sons of Zeus, guard every sailor, their beacons at the Kastor Phalanx went dark when the raiders came. Relight them.",
+"63b73273a690e386": "Two stars, side by side, that sailors look for when the storm is worst. Their beacons had gone out the night the traitor's raiders came.",
+"a621c6ef7c3993d3": "When the Twin Stars burn on a ship's mast, sailors say, the storm is over. The pilot set them burning again, and every ship in the lanes saw them.",
+"56aa53e29492c1b1": "Bad news. At Tie-nah-ron, where the road to Hades opens, the three-headed hound has broken out. Herakles, father of our kings, dragged it up from below once. Now it is your turn.",
+"e64ed494eb9223f8": "Three heads it had, and a mane of snakes, and its bark shook the hulls of ships as the bark of a dog shakes a sleeping house.",
+"c3ac3d519daa7670": "So the hound of Hades went back down the road it came, and the gate of Tie-nah-ron was shut.",
+"1ea983772eea8274": "Come back. Report. Keep it short.",
+"6fe85081b251f830": "A Spartan mother tells her son, as she hands him his shield: 'With it, or on it.' You came back with yours.",
+"3f9ef4ea003dbc38": "Take this. Few strangers are called friends of Lakeh-dye-mon. You are.",
+"204720b69e0b4889": "Sing, Muse, of Mee-keh-nay rich in gold, of its walls that the Sigh-klo-peez built, and of the curse that runs in its kings' blood like rust in a blade.",
+"30d0c2d61521d91f": "Stranger, you stand in the hall of the wah-nax. Drink from my cup, and then hear me, for the gods have turned their faces from my house.",
+"0a509b8f817776f2": "The golden mask of my fathers was taken from the tholos-tomb, and the next night the Lion Gate's beacon went dark, and the great walls cracked.",
+"d01e0c4fd60db20a": "Old Bron-tees, last of the Cyclops-engines, still tends the forge at Tiryns. He built these walls. Ask him what has broken them.",
+"11d51870761b56ff": "Tiryns of the great walls: there the Cyclops-engine still beats its anvil, slow as a heart, as it has since the days of Perseus.",
+"e786675712fa346d": "One eye I have, and with it I have watched three thousand years. Walls do not crack by themselves, little one. A thief opened the tomb, and the dead were angry.",
+"683e075142a47127": "First mend the walls. Bring iron and titanium to the forge at the Lion Gate of Tirynthia, and I will set the stones as I set them for Perseus.",
+"885e899cbf3e0705": "Iron for the bones of the wall, titanium for its sinews. Bring them, and I will make it whole.",
+"01ce88abdd6082f7": "The forge roared like a lion in a cave, and the walls grew whole again, stone locked on stone, so close that no knife-blade could pass between them.",
+"0079fcae0c37d817": "The thieves took the mask towards the den of Lukka. Their sentries watch the gate from Mee-keh-nay. Clear the road.",
+"c9eb36edc9879026": "The pass to Lukka: where the raiders watch, as crows watch a field from the top of a dead tree.",
+"111604a820e351f9": "The road is open. But a worse thing stirs. In the marsh of Lair-na, beside our own world, the many-headed serpent that Herakles killed has grown its heads again.",
+"cc40322665d56d43": "Herakles cut one head and two grew in its place. Do not be proud, pilot. Be patient.",
+"533a19db3f83a1d9": "Nine heads it had, and its breath was poison, and the marsh boiled where it moved.",
+"3bc80c21b328de68": "So the Hydra died a second time; and the pilot did not boast of it, remembering what happens to the proud.",
+"e060539eaa0cc8d0": "Now we sail to take back the mask. But the fleet cannot jump. The gates are still, as the winds were still at Aulis when Artemis was wronged.",
+"d16bfb306fee2c5d": "Kal-kas sees what was, what is and what will be. He has never told a king good news. Go and hear him anyway.",
+"ef5c683517409627": "Artemis is angry. One of the wah-nax's captains shot a hind in her sacred grove and boasted that not even the goddess could shoot better.",
+"888cc85a9e5a62d0": "Once, at Aulis, she asked for a king's daughter. But in the better telling she took a hind instead, and carried the girl away to safety. Give her gifts of healing and clean water, and she will be content.",
+"4caaf928e47d7c3a": "Medicine for her healing hands, water for her clean springs. Artemis loves the wild things, and those who keep them whole.",

+"652332cc9fc65d04": "The Pan-ee-o-nee-on stands on the headland of Mykale, where the twelve Ionian cities met each year to sacrifice to Poseidon and to quarrel.",

+"7ea6d9fc594260f7": "Thay-ah-no of Samos, who keeps the school of Pythagoras, is building the instrument. She needs parts. Bring them to the Sappho Observatory.",

+"468f4cbbeadaeee7": "Be quick and be careful. A man who wants to be remembered will do anything to be noticed.",
+"a650b00593c563f9": "The scouts carried fire-charges, the kind used to burn a station. Pilot, it is the temple of Artemis he means to burn. It is the greatest wonder of the League. Hurry to the temple-ring beside Effesoss Agora.",
+"af48b642952ec865": "The temple of Artemis at Effesoss had a hundred and twenty-seven columns, each the gift of a king. Its ring now shone in the dark beside the Agora like a crown laid on black cloth.",
+"b26123e42be44afa": "Too late to stop him reaching us, not too late to stop him finishing. He is here. Hear him.",
+"f2932ac701ed3806": "Let them burn my body afterwards! My name will outlive their temple, their League and their gods.",

+"6cbdc896d0ce5582": "The shadow came first, but the gates held, by luck and by the gods' patience. Next time, be quicker than luck.",

+"2986dfb012dd4e3d": "What is everything made of? Thaylees said water, Anaximenes air, Herakleitos fire, Pythagoras number. I say: stories. Take the League's gold, the song is free.",

When Lee-toh, carrying the children of Zeus, wandered the world, no land would take her in, for they feared white-armed Hera. Only Delos dared. Then Poseidon fixed it to the sea's floor with four pillars, and there Apollo and Artemis were born.",

+## Every icon button, everywhere (Talos and the game alike): its icon and a

+## tooltip's title) - with the full name, keys and help in its tooltip.
+static func dress(b: Button, icon: String, tooltip: String, label := "") -> Button:

+	"Main menu": "Menu", "Pump from the hold": "Pump", "Accept mission": "Accept",
+	"Test in game": "Test", "Import the main quest": "Import", "Zoom to page": "Fit page",
+	"Snap to grid": "Snap", "Export PNG": "Export", "Reload patches": "Reload",
+	"Open this patch": "Open patch", "Previous step": "Previous", "Next step": "Next",
+	"Play the sound": "Play", "New scenario": "New", "Revert to generated": "Revert",
+	"Hull fully repaired": "Repaired", "Add citizen line": "Add line", "Apply paint": "Apply",
+	"Saved presets": "Presets", "Factory paint": "Factory", "Rename step": "Rename",
+	"Sell all cargo": "Sell all", "Clear route": "Clear", "Brush size": "Brush",
+	"Where and when it's used": "Where used", "Duplicate": "Copy", "Save as": "Save as",
+	"Select and transform": "Select", "Star and polygon": "Star", "Pencil (freehand)": "Pencil",
+	"Pen (Bezier)": "Pen",
+}
+## Titles made at run time ("Land on Amnissos"): their opening words' short form.
+const SHORT_PREFIX := {"Land on ": "Land", "Plot route to ": "Plot route", "Buy the ": "Buy",
+	"Enter: ": "Enter", "Skin: ": "Skin", "Take out ": "Take out", "Sell all ": "Sell all"}
+const FILLER := ["and", "the", "to", "of", "a", "on", "in", "for", "with", "from", "your"]
+
+
+## A button's label from its tooltip ("Title      [keys]\nhelp").
+static func short_label(tooltip: String) -> String:
+	var title := tooltip.get_slice("\n", 0)
+	var k := title.find("      [")
+	if k >= 0:
+		title = title.left(k)
+	title = title.strip_edges()
+	if SHORT.has(title):
+		return SHORT[title]
+	for pre in SHORT_PREFIX:
+		if title.begins_with(pre):
+			return SHORT_PREFIX[pre]
+	if title.length() <= 14:

+	# The first two words - never ending on "and", "the", "to"...
+	var words := Array(title.split(" ", false)).slice(0, 2)
+	while words.size() > 1 and str(words[-1]).to_lower() in FILLER:
+		words.pop_back()
+	return " ".join(words)

+		var verb := short_label(tooltip).get_slice(" ", 0)
+		var worded := value.unicode_at(0) > 64 and value.left(1).to_upper() != value.left(1).to_lower()
+		b.text = (verb + " " + value) if verb != "" and not verb.contains("%") and not worded else value
 		b.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT

hunks.note: dress() now sets a label - given, or made from the tooltip's title by short_label(): a table for long titles, prefixes for titles made at run time, the title itself if 14 characters or fewer, else its first two words without a trailing "and" or "the". action() puts the verb before a number, but shows a worded value as it is.

files.explanation: New: the loading screen for loading a save. It shows over everything in the start-up screen's look, waits two frames so it is on screen before the long load frame, then changes scene under it. A planet save's bar follows the surface as it builds. It fades out once the new game scene is ready, with a 30 s safety timeout.

+class_name LoadVeil
+extends CanvasLayer
+## The loading screen shown while a save loads (SaveGame.load_slot): the
+## start-up loading screen's look - the title's colours, a bar, what's being
+## done - over everything, from the click until the game is there to play.
+## A save made in space: the galaxy and the system are rebuilt (one long
+## frame); one made on a planet: then the surface is built too (the bar
+## follows its build_progress). It fades out once the game scene is ready
+## (SaveGame.travelling back to false; a surface built) - or after TIMEOUT
+## seconds, whatever happened.
+##   LoadVeil.change_to("res://main.tscn", "Loading slot 2")
+
+const TIMEOUT := 30.0
+const FADE := 0.3
+## Of the bar: the space scene; the rest, a planet's surface if there's one.
+const SPACE_SHARE := 0.3
+
+var _bar: ProgressBar
+var _stage: Label
+var _root: Control
+var _t := 0.0
+var _shown := 0.0
+var _ready_frames := 0
+var _closing := false
+## The scene to wait for (tests); else the current scene.
+var watch: Node = null

+## from its menu) - only a new one counts.

+var _changed := false

+## Shows the veil, lets it draw, then changes to `path` under it.
+static func change_to(path: String, title := "Loading") -> LoadVeil:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	var v := LoadVeil.new()
+	v.name = "LoadVeil"
+	tree.root.add_child(v)
+	v._build(title)
+	v._go.call_deferred(path)
+	return v

+func _go(path: String) -> void:
+	# Two frames so the veil is on screen before the long frame of the load.
+	await get_tree().process_frame
+	await get_tree().process_frame
+	get_tree().paused = false

+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _closing:
+		return
+	_t += delta
+	var s := watch if watch != null else get_tree().current_scene
+	var target := 0.05
+	var done := false
+	if (watch != null or (_changed and s != _from)) and s != null and s.has_method("get_save_data"):

+		if surface:
+			target = SPACE_SHARE + (1.0 - SPACE_SHARE) * float(s.get("build_progress"))

+		else:
+			target = SPACE_SHARE
+			done = not SaveGame.travelling
+	_shown = move_toward(_shown, target, delta * 2.0)
+	if done:
+		_ready_frames += 1
+		_shown = 1.0
+	_bar.value = _shown
+	if _ready_frames >= 3 or _t > TIMEOUT:   # (a few frames for the first picture)
+		_close()
+
+
+func _close() -> void:
+	_closing = true
+	var tw := create_tween()
+	tw.tween_property(_root, "modulate:a", 0.0, FADE)
+	tw.tween_callback(queue_free)

+extends TestCase
+## The empires' main quests (tools/empire_quests.py -> data/scenarios.json):
+## each is played from the capital to the end with its walkthrough, through
+## the real rules engine (Scenarios) and a stand-in for the space scene's
+## ScenarioHost - every step reachable, every ship countable, every delivery
+## taken, rewards and the encyclopedia given, the quest finished. Also: the
+## places they name exist, their monsters and ships exist, their text reads

+				r["system"] = Galaxy.current_system

+

+## Plays quest `id` through with its walkthrough; returns the problems.
+func _play(id: String) -> Array:
+	var sc := Scenarios.find(id)

+	var walk: Array = sc.get("walkthrough", [])
+	for i in walk.size():
+		var w: Dictionary = walk[i]
+		var before: String = Scenarios.state[id]["step"]

+		var sc := Scenarios.find("empire_" + e)
+		for r in sc.get("rules", []):
+			var ev: Dictionary = r.get("when", {})
+			var st := str(ev.get("args", {}).get("station", ""))
+			if st != "":
+				check(stations.has(st), "%s: station '%s' exists" % [e, st])
+			for c in r.get("if", []):
+				if c.get("cond") == "in_system":
+					check(Galaxy.systems.has(str(c["args"]["system"])), "%s: system %s exists" % [e, c["args"]["system"]])
+			for a in r.get("then", []):
+				if a.get("action") == "spawn":
+					check(EnemyTypes.has_type(str(a["args"]["ship_type"])), "%s: ship type %s exists" % [e, a["args"]["ship_type"]])
+					check(EnemyTypes.get_type(str(a["args"]["ship_type"])).get("faction", "enemy") == "enemy", "%s: %s is hostile" % [e, a["args"]["ship_type"]])
+		for w in sc.get("walkthrough", []):
+			if not w.has("system"):
+				continue
+			var sysd: Dictionary = Galaxy.system(str(w["system"]))
+			var place := str(w.get("near", ""))
+			if place == "" and w.has("kill"):
+				for r in sc["rules"]:
+					for a in r.get("then", []):
+						if a.get("action") == "spawn" and a["args"]["group"] == w["kill"]:
+							place = str(a["args"]["place"])
+			var kind := place.get_slice(":", 0)
+			var arg := place.substr(kind.length() + 1)
+			match kind:
+				"planet":
+					var names: Array = sysd.get("planets", []).map(func(p): return str(p.get("name", "")) if p is Dictionary else str(p))
+					check(names.has(arg), "%s: planet %s is in %s" % [e, arg, w["system"]])
+				"gate":
+					check(Galaxy.systems[str(w["system"])].get("gates", {}).has(arg), "%s: %s has a gate to %s" % [e, w["system"], arg])
+				"station":
+					check(stations.get(arg, "") == str(w["system"]) or stations.has(arg), "%s: station %s exists" % [e, arg])
+
+
+## The way the stories are told: no modern words, every speaker named, each
+## quest with its invocation of the Muse.
+func test_quests_read_like_old_stories() -> void:
+	var modern := ["okay", "ok", "cool", "guys", "yeah", "awesome", "lol", "hey", "dude", "gonna", "wanna", "hi-tech", "sci-fi", "kid", "stuff", "folks"]
+	for e in EMPIRES:
+		var sc := Scenarios.find("empire_" + e)
+		var all_text := ""
+		var muse := false
+		for r in sc.get("rules", []):
+			for a in r.get("then", []):
+				if a.get("action") == "dialogue":
+					for l in a["args"]["lines"]:
+						check(str(l[0]) != "", "%s: every line has a speaker" % e)
+						all_text += " " + str(l[1]).to_lower()
+						if str(l[1]).begins_with("Sing, Muse"):
+							muse = true
+		check(muse, "%s: the story opens with the Muse" % e)
+		var words := {}
+		for w in all_text.replace(".", " ").replace(",", " ").replace("!", " ").replace("?", " ").replace(";", " ").replace(":", " ").replace("'", " ").split(" ", false):
+			words[w] = true
+		for w in modern:
+			check(not words.has(w), "%s: no modern word '%s'" % [e, w])
+
+
+## A quest's enemies in another system wait there; leaving a system with
+## them alive brings them back when you return (the quest never strands).
+func test_quest_enemies_wait_in_their_system() -> void:
+	var id := "empire_sparta"
+	Scenarios.start(id)
+	Galaxy.current_system = "kyros"
+	Scenarios.event("docked", {"station": "Sparta Barracks"})   # (the prologue; the first fight's ships ordered)
+	var recs: Array = Scenarios.state[id]["spawns"]
+	check(recs.size() == 2 and recs.all(func(r): return r["system"] == ""), "ordered for a gate not here yet: none out (%s)" % [recs])
+	_host.places = {"gate:pylos": Vector2(800, 0)}
+	_host.spawn_pending(id, true)
+	check(recs.all(func(r): return r["system"] == "kyros"), "arriving where the gate is: they come out there")
+	Scenarios.group_ship_lost(id, "g1", 0)   # one of three falls, then you jump away and back
+	check(int(recs[0]["left"]) == 1, "the fallen one is counted")
+	check(Scenarios.state[id]["step"].begins_with("1 "), "still on the fight")
+	for ri in recs.size():
+		for n in int(recs[ri]["left"]):
+			Scenarios.group_ship_lost(id, "g1", ri)
+	check(Scenarios.state[id]["step"].begins_with("2 "), "all three down: the quest moves on (%s)" % Scenarios.state[id]["step"])
+
+
+## An old save (made before these quests existed) gets them, from their beginning.
+func test_old_saves_get_the_quests() -> void:
+	Scenarios.load_save_data({"missing_freighter": {"status": "not started", "step": ""}})
+	for e in EMPIRES:
+		check(Scenarios.state.has("empire_" + e) and Scenarios.state["empire_" + e]["status"] == "active", "%s's quest waits in an old save" % e)
+		check(Scenarios.state["empire_" + e]["step"] == "Not started", "%s's from its start" % e)
+
+
+## Kilon Alios has something to say of every people, and the story of New Hellas.
+func test_kilon_tells_of_every_people() -> void:
+	var emp: Dictionary = QuestData.GIVER.get("empires", {})
+	for e in Galaxy.MAJOR + ["pirates", "independent"]:
+		check(emp.has(e), "Kilon speaks of the %s" % Galaxy.empire_name(e))
+		if emp.has(e):
+			check(not (emp[e].get("greeting", []) as Array).is_empty(), "%s: his greeting there" % e)
+			check((emp[e].get("topics", []) as Array).size() >= (3 if e in Galaxy.MAJOR else 1), "%s: his topics there" % e)
+	check((QuestData.GIVER.get("hellas", []) as Array).size() >= 5, "the story of New Hellas, in parts")
+	# And he tells the empires' stories himself.
+	for e in EMPIRES:
+		var speakers := {}
+		for r in Scenarios.find("empire_" + e).get("rules", []):
+			for a in r.get("then", []):
+				if a.get("action") == "dialogue":
+					for l in a["args"]["lines"]:
+						speakers[str(l[0])] = true
+		check(speakers.has("Kilon Alios"), "%s: Kilon Alios tells it" % e)
+
+
+## On a world the Athenians hold: Kilon is there and speaks of them, the
+## buildings are Athenian (named, materials, their own furniture).
+func test_an_athenian_world() -> void:
+	var was := Galaxy.current_system
+	Galaxy.current_system = "nyx"   # (Athenai)
+	SaveGame.space_state = {}
+	SaveGame.landed_planet = "selene"   # (not Amnissos, Kilon's home world)
+	var s: Node = load("res://scenes/planet_surface.tscn").instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(s)
+	while not s.is_built:
+		await tree.process_frame
+	check_eq(s.culture(), "athens", "the planet's culture: its system's owner")
+	check(s.quest_giver != null, "Kilon Alios stands by the landing pad")
+	check(not s.quest_giver.offering, "no quest sign over him away from Amnissos")
+	var topics: Array = s._giver_culture().get("topics", [])
+	check(topics.size() >= 3 and str(topics[0]["ask"]).contains("Athenians"), "he speaks of the Athenians")
+	var names: Array = s.buildings.map(func(b): return str(b.title))
+	check(names.any(func(n): return n.begins_with("Athenian")), "Athenian buildings: %s" % [names])
+	check(s._furniture_for("palace").has("owl"), "Athena's owl among the furniture")
+	check(not s._furniture_for("temple").has("goddess") and not s._furniture_for("temple").has("labrys"), "no Minoan snake goddess or double axe in an Athenian temple")
+	check(MinoanTiles.style("palace") == MinoanTiles.STYLES["athens_palace"], "Athenian buildings of their own (not the Minoan pieces)")
+	check(s._building_skin == null, "no recolouring over their own art")
+	var people := s.find_children("*", "", true, false).filter(func(n): return n is SurfaceProps.MinoanNpc and not n is SurfaceProps.QuestGiver)
+	var rigs := {}
+	for n in people:
+		rigs[n.rig_name] = int(rigs.get(n.rig_name, 0)) + 1
+	rigs.erase("pirate")   # (raiders come to every world)
+	check(rigs.keys() == ["athenian"], "the citizens are Athenians: %s" % [rigs])
+	check(Furniture.picture("chair", "ne")[0].resource_path.contains("/athens/"), "Athenian furniture")
+	s.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+	Galaxy.current_system = was
+	SaveGame.landed_planet = ""
+
+
+## The empires' furniture, drawn in code: each piece draws (against either wall).
+func test_empire_furniture_draws() -> void:
+	for k in ["owl", "krater", "shield_rack", "lion_relief", "ionic_column", "star_globe", "idol"]:
+		for w in ["nw", "ne"]:
+			var f: Furniture = Furniture.new().setup(k, w, Vector2i(3, 3), Vector2(100, 100), "palace")
+			tree.root.add_child(f)
+			check(f.texture == null and f.height > 30.0, "%s: drawn in code, %d px tall" % [k, f.height])
+			f.queue_redraw()
+			await tree.process_frame
+			check_eq(f.display_name(), Furniture.KINDS[k][0], "%s: its name" % k)
+			f.queue_free()
+
+
+## Every building style (the Minoans' and the empires' own) has every part a
+## building needs, and every piece it names is drawn (data/sprites).
+func test_building_styles_complete() -> void:
+	for st in MinoanTiles.STYLES:
+		var d: Dictionary = MinoanTiles.STYLES[st]
+		for k in ["plain", "window", "door", "floor", "mosaic", "roof", "column", "caps", "antenna", "dome", "horns", "decor", "entrance"]:
+			check(d.has(k), "%s has its %s" % [st, k])
+		check((d.get("caps", []) as Array).size() >= 3, "%s: a cap for each of the roof's 3 corners" % st)
+		check((d.get("entrance", []) as Array).size() >= 2, "%s: two pieces by the door" % st)
+		var pieces: Array = d["floor"] + d["mosaic"] + d["roof"] + d["caps"] + d["decor"] + d["entrance"] + [d["column"], d["antenna"], d["dome"], d["horns"]]
+		for design in d["plain"] + d["window"] + [d["door"]]:
+			for o in ["x", "y"]:
+				pieces.append(MinoanTiles._wall_piece(design, o))
+		for p in pieces:
+			check(ResourceLoader.exists("res://data/sprites/tile_%s.png" % p), "%s: its piece %s is drawn" % [st, p])
+
+
+## Every empire's worlds are its own: on a planet it holds, its buildings,
+## its people and its furniture (none of the Minoans'), Kilon by the pad.
+func test_every_empire_world_is_its_own() -> void:
+	var holds := {"athens": "nyx", "sparta": "kyros", "mycenae": "naxos", "ionia": "miletos", "cyclades": "g40_delos"}
+	var rigs := {"athens": "athenian", "sparta": "spartan", "mycenae": "mycenaean", "ionia": "ionian", "cyclades": "cycladic"}
+	var was := Galaxy.current_system
+	for e in holds:
+		Galaxy.current_system = holds[e]
+		SaveGame.space_state = {}
+		SaveGame.landed_planet = "selene"
+		var s: Node = load("res://scenes/planet_surface.tscn").instantiate()
+		tree.root.add_child(s)
+		while not s.is_built:
+			await tree.process_frame
+		check_eq(s.culture(), e, "%s holds the world" % e)
+		check(MinoanTiles.style("temple") == MinoanTiles.STYLES[e + "_temple"], "%s: its own temples" % e)
+		check(s._building_skin == null, "%s: no recolouring" % e)
+		var found := {}
+		for n in s.find_children("*", "", true, false):
+			if n is SurfaceProps.MinoanNpc and n.rig_name != "pirate":
+				found[n.rig_name] = true
+		check(found.keys() == [rigs[e]], "%s: its own people (%s)" % [e, found.keys()])
+		check(Furniture.picture("bed", "ne")[0].resource_path.contains("/%s/" % e), "%s: its own furniture" % e)
+		check(s.quest_giver != null, "%s: Kilon by the pad" % e)
+		s.queue_free()
+		await tree.process_frame
+	Galaxy.current_system = was
+	SaveGame.landed_planet = ""

+extends TestCase
+## Text stays readable and at the player's size: on every page of every
+## menu, at 130% "Menus & panels" text, after the page is rebuilt (what a
+## purchase, an equip, a mission accepted does), every text control is at
+## its screen's size (UI.scale_fonts' mark; UI.fit_text for text added
+## later) - none back at 100% - and none, anywhere on screen (HUDs too), is
+## under Settings.MIN_FONT.
+
+const SCALE := 1.3
+
+
+func _settle() -> void:
+	for i in 3:

+
+
+## Text controls showing under `root` whose size isn't their screen's (the
+## nearest ancestor UI.scale_fonts marked) - e.g. built after the screen was
+## scaled and never scaled themselves.
+func _unscaled(root: Node) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for n in root.find_children("*", "Control", true, false):
+		var keys := UI._text_keys(n)
+		if keys.is_empty() or not n.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		var mark: Array = []
+		var p: Node = n
+		while p != null:
+			if p.has_meta("fixed_font"):
+				break
+			if p.has_meta("text_scale"):
+				mark = p.get_meta("text_scale")
+				break
+			p = p.get_parent()
+		if mark.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var s := minf(Settings.font_scale(str(mark[0])), float(mark[1]))
+		var key: String = keys[0]
+		if not n.has_meta("base_" + key):
+			out.append("%s (%s): never scaled" % [n.name, _text(n)])
+			continue
+		var want := maxi(Settings.MIN_FONT, roundi(n.get_meta("base_" + key) * s))
+		if n.get_theme_font_size(key) != want:
+			out.append("%s (%s): %d, not %d" % [n.name, _text(n), n.get_theme_font_size(key), want])
+	return out
+
+
+## Text controls showing under `root` smaller than Settings.MIN_FONT.
+func _small(root: Node) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for n in root.find_children("*", "Control", true, false):
+		var keys := UI._text_keys(n)
+		if keys.is_empty() or not n.is_visible_in_tree():
+			continue
+		if n.get_theme_font_size(keys[0]) < Settings.MIN_FONT:
+			out.append("%s (%s): %d px" % [n.name, _text(n), n.get_theme_font_size(keys[0])])
+	return out
+
+
+func _text(n: Control) -> String:
+	var t := str(n.get("text")) if n.get("text") != null else ""
+	return t.left(30).replace("\n", " ")
+
+
+func _check(root: Node, what: String) -> void:
+	var u := _unscaled(root)
+	check(u.is_empty(), "%s: text not at the screen's size: %s" % [what, u.slice(0, 6)])
+	var sm := _small(root)
+	check(sm.is_empty(), "%s: text under %d px: %s" % [what, Settings.MIN_FONT, sm.slice(0, 6)])
+
+

files.explanation: New. Makes each empire's citizens from the Minoan guard's frames: the head is cut off at the neck, a new dinosaur head is drawn facing the same way, and the body is recoloured. 16 frames per people.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,316 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""The empires' citizens, made procedurally from the Minoan guard's sheets
+(art/guard/guard_<pose>_<dir>.png): each frame's triceratops head is cut
+off at the neck and a culture's own head drawn in its place, facing the
+same way, and the body recoloured to the culture's materials. Written as a
+rig of its own (art/<rig>/<rig>_<pose>_<dir>.png) - SheetPuppet loads it
+like any other; PlanetSurface's citizens use it on the culture's worlds.
+
+    Sparta: a tyrannosaur head in bronze plates with a scarlet horsehair
+            crest along the skull (a hoplite's helmet), on an iron body.
+
+    python3 tools/empire_citizens.py        (then godot --import)
+"""
+import colorsys
+import math
+import os
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+SRC = os.path.join(ROOT, "art", "guard")
+DIRS = ["s", "se", "e", "ne", "n", "nw", "w", "sw"]
+POSES = ["idle", "aim"]
+
+
+def rgb(h):
+    h = h.lstrip("#")
+    return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+
+
+def shade(c, k):
+    return tuple(max(0, min(255, int(v * k))) for v in c[:3]) + (255,)
+
+
+def neck_row(img):
+    """The neck: the narrowest opaque row between the frill and the shoulders."""
+    w, h = img.size
+    a = img.split()[3].load()
+    widths = []
+    for y in range(h):
+        xs = [x for x in range(w) if a[x, y] > 100]
+        widths.append((max(xs) - min(xs) + 1, (min(xs) + max(xs)) / 2) if xs else (0, w / 2))
+    lo, hi = int(h * 0.2), int(h * 0.36)
+    best = min(range(lo, hi), key=lambda y: widths[y][0] if widths[y][0] > 0 else 999)
+    return best, widths[best][1], widths
+
+
+def recolor(img, spec):
+    """The body's materials: cream ceramic -> the culture's metal; reds kept
+    (darkened to its scarlet); gold -> its bronze."""
+    px = img.load()
+    w, h = img.size
+    for y in range(h):
+        for x in range(w):
+            r, g, b, a = px[x, y]
+            if a == 0:
+                continue
+            hh, ss, vv = colorsys.rgb_to_hsv(r / 255, g / 255, b / 255)
+            if 0.05 <= hh <= 0.16 and ss < 0.62 and vv > 0.5:          # cream / tan ceramic
+                c = spec["body"]
+                k = vv * 0.95
+                px[x, y] = (int(c[0] * k), int(c[1] * k), int(c[2] * k), a)
+            elif 0.08 <= hh <= 0.16 and ss >= 0.62:                       # gold trim
+                c = spec["bronze"]
+                k = 0.6 + vv * 0.5
+                px[x, y] = (min(255, int(c[0] * k)), min(255, int(c[1] * k)), min(255, int(c[2] * k)), a)
+            elif (hh < 0.04 or hh > 0.95) and ss > 0.45 and vv > 0.55:    # bright reds: the culture's scarlet
+                c = spec["scarlet"]
+                k = 0.45 + vv * 0.7
+                px[x, y] = (min(255, int(c[0] * k)), min(255, int(c[1] * k)), min(255, int(c[2] * k)), a)
+            elif (hh < 0.06 or hh > 0.93) and ss > 0.35 and vv > 0.12:    # the Minoan maroons (dark reds): the culture's own, deep
+                c = spec.get("dark", spec["scarlet"])
+                k = 0.25 + vv * 0.75
+                px[x, y] = (min(255, int(c[0] * k)), min(255, int(c[1] * k)), min(255, int(c[2] * k)), a)
+            elif 0.04 <= hh < 0.08 and ss > 0.5 and vv > 0.3:             # oranges (glowing vents, terracotta): its metal
+                c = spec["bronze"]
+                k = 0.5 + vv * 0.6
+                px[x, y] = (min(255, int(c[0] * k)), min(255, int(c[1] * k)), min(255, int(c[2] * k)), a)
+    return img
+
+
+# --- The tyrannosaur head ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+def _crest_side(d, P, s, spec, kind, L, Hs):
+    c = spec["crest"] + (255,)
+    if kind == "horsehair":     # a hoplite's crest: a ridge of horsehair from the back of the skull forward
+        for k in range(12):
+            x0 = -12 + k * 3.6
+            top = -Hs - 8 - 10 * (1 - abs(k - 5.5) / 6)
+            d.line([P(x0, -Hs * 0.8 if k > 2 else -14), P(x0 - 2, top)], fill=c, width=max(2, int(3 * s)))
+    elif kind == "feathers":    # a raptor's feathers, swept back like an owl's tufts
+        for k in range(9):
+            x0 = -4 - k * 2.5
+            d.polygon([P(x0 + 6, -Hs + 2), P(x0 - 10, -Hs - 6 - k * 1.2), P(x0 - 2, -Hs + 6)], fill=c)
+        for k in range(5):
+            d.polygon([P(-10 - k * 3, -6 + k * 3), P(-22 - k * 3, -2 + k * 4), P(-12 - k * 3, 0 + k * 3)], fill=shade(spec["crest"], 0.85))
+    elif kind == "dome":        # a pachycephalosaur's thick bony dome, studded
+        d.ellipse([P(-14, -Hs - 16)[0] if P(-14, 0)[0] < P(26, 0)[0] else P(26, 0)[0], P(0, -Hs - 16)[1],
+                   P(26, 0)[0] if P(-14, 0)[0] < P(26, 0)[0] else P(-14, 0)[0], P(0, -Hs + 8)[1]], fill=c)
+        for k in range(5):
+            x, y = P(-10 + k * 8, -Hs - 4 + abs(k - 2) * 3)
+            d.ellipse([x - 2 * s, y - 2 * s, x + 2 * s, y + 2 * s], fill=shade(spec["crest"], 0.7))
+    elif kind == "tube":        # a parasaurolophus's long hollow crest, sweeping back
+        d.polygon([P(18, -Hs + 2), P(-30, -Hs - 22), P(-36, -Hs - 16), P(8, -Hs + 8)], fill=c)
+        d.line([P(14, -Hs + 1), P(-32, -Hs - 18)], fill=shade(spec["crest"], 1.3), width=max(1, int(2 * s)))
+    elif kind == "sail":        # a spinosaur's spines, rising behind the skull
+        for k in range(8):
+            x0 = -2 - k * 4
+            d.line([P(x0, -Hs + 6), P(x0 - 2, -Hs - 6 - 8 * math.sin(k / 7 * math.pi))], fill=c, width=max(2, int(3 * s)))
+        d.polygon([P(0, -Hs + 6), P(-30, -Hs + 6), P(-30, -Hs - 4), P(-2, -Hs - 10)], fill=spec["crest"] + (140,))
+
+
+def head_side(d, nx, ny, s, spec, flip=False, fore=1.0):
+    """In profile, snout towards +x (or -x if flip). (nx, ny): the neck's top;
+    s: scale; fore < 1: foreshortened (three-quarter). The head's shape from
+    spec["head"]: snout length, skull height, teeth or not, crest kind."""
+    hd = spec["head"]
+    L, Hs = hd["snout"], hd["skull"]
+    f = -1 if flip else 1
+
+    def P(x, y):
+        return (nx + f * x * s * fore, ny + y * s)
+    br, dark = spec["bronze"], shade(spec["bronze"], 0.55)
+    skull = [P(-14, 2), P(-16, -Hs * 0.56), P(-6, -Hs * 0.94), P(14, -Hs), P(L * 0.65, -Hs * 0.81), P(L * 0.94, -Hs * 0.62),
+             P(L, -Hs * 0.38), P(L * 0.97, -4), P(L * 0.5, -2), P(6, 4)]
+    jaw = [P(4, 2), P(L * 0.5, 0), P(L * 0.9, 2), P(L * 0.87, 10), P(L * 0.45, 12), P(0, 14), P(-8, 8)]
+    _crest_side(d, P, s, spec, hd["crest"], L, Hs)
+    d.polygon(jaw, fill=shade(br, 0.8))
+    d.polygon(skull, fill=br + (255,))
+    d.line([P(8, -2), P(L * 0.94, -4)], fill=dark, width=max(1, int(2 * s)))            # the mouth line
+    if hd.get("teeth", True):
+        n = int(L / 9)
+        for k in range(n):
+            x = 14 + k * (L * 0.75 / n)
+            d.polygon([P(x, -3), P(x + 2.5, 4), P(x + 5, -3)], fill=(240, 236, 220, 255))
+    else:   # a beak's edge
+        d.line([P(L * 0.6, -2), P(L, -6)], fill=shade(spec["crest"], 0.9), width=max(2, int(3 * s)))
+    d.line([P(-4, -Hs * 0.7), P(L * 0.55, -Hs * 0.84)], fill=shade(br, 1.35), width=max(1, int(2 * s)))   # light on the plates
+    d.polygon([P(10, -Hs * 0.75), P(22, -Hs * 0.88), P(18, -Hs * 0.62)], fill=dark)       # brow ridge
+    ex, ey = P(16, -Hs * 0.62)
+    r = 2.6 * s * hd.get("eye", 1.0)
+    d.ellipse([ex - r, ey - r, ex + r, ey + r], fill=spec["eye"] + (255,))
+    nx2, ny2 = P(L * 0.92, -Hs * 0.5)
+    d.ellipse([nx2 - 1.6 * s, ny2 - 1.2 * s, nx2 + 1.6 * s, ny2 + 1.2 * s], fill=dark)   # nostril
+
+
+def head_front(d, nx, ny, s, spec):
+    hd = spec["head"]
+    br, dark = spec["bronze"], shade(spec["bronze"], 0.55)
+    w = 24 * s * hd.get("width", 1.0)
+    Hs = hd["skull"]
+    kind = hd["crest"]
+    c = spec["crest"] + (255,)
+    if kind == "dome":
+        d.ellipse([nx - w * 0.85, ny - (Hs + 18) * s, nx + w * 0.85, ny - (Hs - 10) * s], fill=c)
+    elif kind == "tube":
+        d.polygon([(nx - 4 * s, ny - Hs * s), (nx - 6 * s, ny - (Hs + 26) * s), (nx + 6 * s, ny - (Hs + 26) * s), (nx + 4 * s, ny - Hs * s)], fill=c)
+    elif kind == "feathers":
+        for side in (-1, 1):
+            d.polygon([(nx + side * w * 0.5, ny - Hs * s), (nx + side * w * 1.1, ny - (Hs + 14) * s), (nx + side * w * 0.9, ny - (Hs - 4) * s)], fill=c)
+    elif kind == "sail":
+        for k in range(5):
+            d.line([(nx - 2 * s + k, ny - Hs * s), (nx - 2 * s + k, ny - (Hs + 16) * s)], fill=c, width=max(2, int(2 * s)))
+    d.polygon([(nx - w, ny), (nx - w * 1.05, ny - Hs * 0.62 * s), (nx - w * 0.6, ny - Hs * s), (nx + w * 0.6, ny - Hs * s),
+               (nx + w * 1.05, ny - Hs * 0.62 * s), (nx + w, ny)], fill=br + (255,))
+    d.polygon([(nx - w * 0.9, ny - 2 * s), (nx + w * 0.9, ny - 2 * s), (nx + w * 0.75, ny + 10 * s), (nx - w * 0.75, ny + 10 * s)], fill=shade(br, 0.8))
+    d.line([(nx - w * 0.9, ny - 3 * s), (nx + w * 0.9, ny - 3 * s)], fill=dark, width=max(1, int(2 * s)))
+    if hd.get("teeth", True):
+        for k in range(8):
+            x = nx - w * 0.8 + k * w * 0.23
+            d.polygon([(x, ny - 4 * s), (x + 2.5 * s, ny + 3 * s), (x + 5 * s, ny - 4 * s)], fill=(240, 236, 220, 255))
+    for side in (-1, 1):
+        ex, ey = nx + side * w * 0.62, ny - Hs * 0.68 * s
+        r = 3 * s * hd.get("eye", 1.0)
+        d.ellipse([ex - r, ey - r, ex + r, ey + r], fill=spec["eye"] + (255,))
+        d.polygon([(ex - 5 * s, ey - 5 * s), (ex + 5 * s, ey - 6 * s), (ex, ey - 2 * s)], fill=dark)
+        d.ellipse([nx + side * 5 * s - 1.5 * s, ny - 12 * s, nx + side * 5 * s + 1.5 * s, ny - 9 * s], fill=dark)
+    if kind == "horsehair":
+        d.polygon([(nx - 4 * s, ny - Hs * s), (nx, ny - (Hs + 20) * s), (nx + 4 * s, ny - Hs * s)], fill=c)   # crest, end-on
+
+
+def head_back(d, nx, ny, s, spec, snout=0):
+    hd = spec["head"]
+    br = spec["bronze"]
+    w = 20 * s * hd.get("width", 1.0)
+    Hs = hd["skull"] + 6
+    kind = hd["crest"]
+    c = spec["crest"] + (255,)
+    if kind == "tube":
+        d.polygon([(nx - 5 * s, ny - (Hs - 4) * s), (nx - 7 * s, ny - (Hs + 24) * s), (nx + 7 * s, ny - (Hs + 24) * s), (nx + 5 * s, ny - (Hs - 4) * s)], fill=c)
+    if kind == "dome":
+        d.ellipse([nx - w * 0.95, ny - (Hs + 14) * s, nx + w * 0.95, ny - (Hs - 14) * s], fill=c)
+    d.polygon([(nx - w * 0.7, ny + 2 * s), (nx - w, ny - Hs * 0.42 * s), (nx - w * 0.75, ny - Hs * 0.84 * s), (nx, ny - Hs * s),
+               (nx + w * 0.75, ny - Hs * 0.84 * s), (nx + w, ny - Hs * 0.42 * s), (nx + w * 0.7, ny + 2 * s)], fill=shade(br, 0.85))
+    for k in range(4):   # (the plates' edges)
+        y = ny - Hs * 0.78 * s + k * 8 * s
+        d.arc([nx - w * 0.9, y - 4 * s, nx + w * 0.9, y + 6 * s], 20, 160, fill=shade(br, 0.6), width=max(1, int(1.5 * s)))
+    if snout:   # (three-quarter from behind: the snout's end shows past the skull)
+        d.polygon([(nx + snout * w * 0.6, ny - 20 * s), (nx + snout * (w + 18 * s), ny - 12 * s), (nx + snout * w * 0.7, ny - 4 * s)], fill=br + (255,))
+    if kind == "horsehair":
+        for k in range(9):
+            y = ny - (Hs + 8) * s + k * 4.6 * s
+            d.line([(nx - 3 * s, y), (nx + 3 * s, y + 2 * s)], fill=c, width=max(2, int(4 * s)))
+        d.line([(nx, ny - (Hs + 12) * s), (nx, ny - 4 * s)], fill=c, width=max(3, int(6 * s)))
+    elif kind == "feathers":
+        for k in range(7):
+            x = nx - w * 0.7 + k * w * 0.23
+            d.polygon([(x, ny - Hs * 0.8 * s), (x + 3 * s, ny - (Hs + 8) * s), (x + 6 * s, ny - Hs * 0.8 * s)], fill=c)
+    elif kind == "sail":
+        for k in range(6):
+            y = ny - (Hs + 4) * s + k * 6 * s
+            d.line([(nx, y), (nx, y - 10 * s)], fill=c, width=max(2, int(3 * s)))
+
+
+def head(d, view, nx, ny, s, spec):
+    if view == "s":
+        head_front(d, nx, ny, s, spec)
+    elif view == "e":
+        head_side(d, nx - 4 * s, ny, s, spec)
+    elif view == "w":
+        head_side(d, nx + 4 * s, ny, s, spec, flip=True)
+    elif view == "se":
+        head_side(d, nx - 8 * s, ny, s, spec, fore=0.7)
+    elif view == "sw":
+        head_side(d, nx + 8 * s, ny, s, spec, flip=True, fore=0.7)
+    elif view == "n":
+        head_back(d, nx, ny, s, spec)
+    elif view == "ne":
+        head_back(d, nx, ny, s, spec, snout=1)
+    elif view == "nw":
+        head_back(d, nx, ny, s, spec, snout=-1)
+
+
+def painted_head(view, nx, ny, s, spec, size, k=3):
+    """The head drawn k times larger, then lit from above, speckled with
+    scales, outlined dark like the painted bodies, and shrunk (smooth)."""
+    W, H = size[0] * k, size[1] * k
+    layer = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (0, 0, 0, 0))
+    head(ImageDraw.Draw(layer), view, nx * k, ny * k, s * k, spec)
+    a = layer.split()[3]
+    bbox = a.getbbox()
+    if not bbox:
+        return Image.new("RGBA", size, (0, 0, 0, 0))
+    top, bottom = bbox[1], bbox[3]
+    px = layer.load()
+    import random
+    rnd = random.Random(7)
+    for y in range(top, bottom):
+        light = 1.18 - 0.45 * (y - top) / max(1, bottom - top)
+        for x in range(bbox[0], bbox[2]):
+            r, g, b, al = px[x, y]
+            if al == 0:
+                continue
+            sc = 0.9 if rnd.random() < 0.08 else 1.0          # scales
+            kk = light * sc
+            px[x, y] = (min(255, int(r * kk)), min(255, int(g * kk)), min(255, int(b * kk)), al)
+    # a dark outline round it all (the bodies' painted line)
+    from PIL import ImageFilter
+    grown = a.filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(2 * k + 1))
+    outline = Image.new("RGBA", (W, H), (28, 18, 12, 255))
+    outline.putalpha(grown)
+    outline.alpha_composite(layer)
+    return outline.resize(size, Image.LANCZOS)
+
+
+def make(spec):
+    out = os.path.join(ROOT, "art", spec["rig"])
+    os.makedirs(out, exist_ok=True)
+    n = 0
+    scales = {}
+    for pose in POSES:
+        for view in DIRS:
+            src = os.path.join(SRC, "guard_%s_%s.png" % (pose, view))
+            img = Image.open(src).convert("RGBA")
+            ny, nx, widths = neck_row(img)
+            w, h = img.size
+            px = img.load()
+            for y in range(ny + 1):         # the old head and frill: gone
+                for x in range(w):
+                    px[x, y] = (0, 0, 0, 0)
+            img = recolor(img, spec)
+            # the new head stands on the neck; its size from the shoulders' width
+            shoulders = max(wd for wd, _ in widths[ny:ny + int(h * 0.12)])
+            s = scales.setdefault(view, max(0.75, min(1.15, shoulders / 82.0)))   # (the idle frame's: a rifle widens the aiming ones)
+            img.alpha_composite(painted_head(view, nx, ny + 6 * s, s, spec, img.size))
+            # the same canvas size, so the feet anchor stays where it was
+            img.save(os.path.join(out, "%s_%s_%s.png" % (spec["rig"], pose, view)))
+            n += 1
+    return n
+
+
+# Each people: its rig (art/<rig>/), the head's metal, the body's material,
+# its reds, the eye, the crest; the head's shape (tyrannosaur, raptor...).
+SPARTA = {"rig": "spartan", "bronze": rgb("b07a36"), "body": rgb("6e6a66"), "scarlet": rgb("a8231b"), "dark": rgb("5a1410"),
+          "crest": rgb("a8231b"), "eye": (255, 170, 40),
+          "head": {"snout": 62, "skull": 32, "teeth": True, "crest": "horsehair"}}           # tyrannosaur
+ATHENS = {"rig": "athenian", "bronze": rgb("c9b48a"), "body": rgb("e6e1d6"), "scarlet": rgb("2e5aa8"), "dark": rgb("1c2e5a"),
+          "crest": rgb("8a7a62"), "eye": (240, 200, 60),
+          "head": {"snout": 46, "skull": 26, "teeth": True, "crest": "feathers", "eye": 1.5, "width": 0.85}}   # raptor, owl-eyed
+
+MYCENAE = {"rig": "mycenaean", "bronze": rgb("d6a842"), "body": rgb("8a6a40"), "scarlet": rgb("8a2a1c"), "dark": rgb("3a2a1a"),
+           "crest": rgb("7a2418"), "eye": (255, 220, 120),
+           "head": {"snout": 40, "skull": 30, "teeth": True, "crest": "dome", "width": 1.05}}      # pachycephalosaur
+IONIA = {"rig": "ionian", "bronze": rgb("3a52a0"), "body": rgb("d8d2c4"), "scarlet": rgb("2a3e8a"), "dark": rgb("1a2450"),
+         "crest": rgb("e3b74a"), "eye": (250, 230, 150),
+         "head": {"snout": 50, "skull": 24, "teeth": False, "crest": "tube", "width": 0.9}}        # parasaurolophus
+CYCLADES = {"rig": "cycladic", "bronze": rgb("c8c4b8"), "body": rgb("f0eee8"), "scarlet": rgb("2f6fb0"), "dark": rgb("1a1c22"),
+            "crest": rgb("1a1c22"), "eye": (120, 200, 255),
+            "head": {"snout": 66, "skull": 22, "teeth": True, "crest": "sail", "width": 0.8}}       # spinosaur
+
+PEOPLES = {"spartan": SPARTA, "athenian": ATHENS, "mycenaean": MYCENAE, "ionian": IONIA, "cycladic": CYCLADES}
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+    for k in (sys.argv[1:] or list(PEOPLES)):
+        print("%s: %d frames" % (k, make(PEOPLES[k])))

@@ -1,0 +1,587 @@ 
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""The empires' furniture, drawn procedurally: every picture the Minoan
+furniture uses (Furniture.KINDS), in a culture's own forms and materials,
+written to art/furniture/<culture>/<picture>.png with its anchors
+(art/furniture/<culture>/anchors.json: the footprint's centre in the
+picture). Furniture.picture() takes a culture's own where it has one.
+
+Pieces are built from isometric boxes, cylinders and flat shapes in the
+game's projection (one floor cell = I (+i, down-right) and J (+j,
+down-left), at the pictures' scale: Furniture.ART_K), lit like the
+code-drawn vault (+i face darkest, +j face a little, the top bright).
+Pieces with a front come in two facings: "_a" faces down-left (+j, against
+the "ne" wall), "_b" down-right (+i, against "nw") - the mirror image.
+
+    python3 tools/empire_furniture.py        (then godot --import)
+"""
+import json
+import math
+import os
+
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
+
+ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
+ART_K = 0.534
+I = (64 / ART_K, 32 / ART_K)       # one cell along +i, picture px
+J = (-64 / ART_K, 32 / ART_K)
+H = 1 / ART_K                      # one game px of height, picture px
+C = (300, 360)                     # the anchor on the work canvas
+
+
+def rgb(h):
+    h = h.lstrip("#")
+    return tuple(int(h[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (0, 2, 4))
+
+
+def sh(c, k):
+    return tuple(max(0, min(255, int(v * k))) for v in c[:3]) + (255,)
+
+
+class Pic:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.img = Image.new("RGBA", (600, 480), (0, 0, 0, 0))
+        self.d = ImageDraw.Draw(self.img)
+
+    def p(self, i, j, h=0.0):
+        return (C[0] + I[0] * i + J[0] * j, C[1] + I[1] * i + J[1] * j - h * H)
+
+    def box(self, i0, i1, j0, j1, h0, h1, col, line=True):
+        P = self.p
+        top = [P(i0, j0, h1), P(i1, j0, h1), P(i1, j1, h1), P(i0, j1, h1)]
+        fi = [P(i1, j0, h0), P(i1, j1, h0), P(i1, j1, h1), P(i1, j0, h1)]
+        fj = [P(i0, j1, h0), P(i1, j1, h0), P(i1, j1, h1), P(i0, j1, h1)]
+        o = (20, 14, 10, 160)
+        for poly, k in ((fi, 0.72), (fj, 0.92), (top, 1.14)):
+            self.d.polygon(poly, fill=sh(col, k), outline=o if line else None)
+
+    def cyl(self, i, j, r, h0, h1, col, n=24):
+        """A vertical cylinder (radius r cells) - lit from the left."""
+        cx, cy0 = self.p(i, j, h0)
+        _, cy1 = self.p(i, j, h1)
+        rx, ry = r * I[0] * 1.414, r * I[1] * 1.414
+        for x in range(int(cx - rx), int(cx + rx) + 1):
+            t = (x - (cx - rx)) / max(1, 2 * rx)
+            k = 1.2 - 0.6 * t
+            dy = ry * math.sqrt(max(0.0, 1 - ((x - cx) / rx) ** 2))
+            self.d.line([x, cy1 + dy, x, cy0 + dy], fill=sh(col, k))
+        self.d.ellipse([cx - rx, cy1 - ry, cx + rx, cy1 + ry], fill=sh(col, 1.18), outline=(20, 14, 10, 140))
+
+    def disc(self, i, j, r, h, col):
+        cx, cy = self.p(i, j, h)
+        rx, ry = r * I[0] * 1.414, r * I[1] * 1.414
+        self.d.ellipse([cx - rx, cy - ry, cx + rx, cy + ry], fill=sh(col, 1.0), outline=(20, 14, 10, 140))
+
+    def flat(self, pts, col, h=0.5):
+        self.d.polygon([self.p(i, j, h) for i, j in pts], fill=sh(col, 1.05), outline=(20, 14, 10, 120))
+
+    def line(self, a, b, col, w=3):
+        self.d.line([self.p(*a), self.p(*b)], fill=sh(col, 1.0), width=w)
+
+    def fire(self, i, j, h, s=1.0):
+        x, y = self.p(i, j, h)
+        for k, c in enumerate([(255, 210, 90), (255, 140, 40), (220, 60, 20)]):
+            w = (14 - k * 3) * s
+            self.d.polygon([(x - w, y), (x, y - (34 - k * 8) * s), (x + w, y)], fill=c + (255,))
+
+    def done(self):
+        bb = self.img.getbbox()
+        img = self.img.crop(bb)
+        return img, [round(C[0] - bb[0], 1), round(C[1] - bb[1], 1)]
+
+
+# --- Sparta: plain wood, iron, bronze, scarlet wool, black-glazed clay ------------------
+
+SP = {"wood": rgb("6a4528"), "dark": rgb("3e2a1a"), "iron": rgb("57534f"), "bronze": rgb("b07a36"),
+      "scarlet": rgb("a8231b"), "stone": rgb("9a9184"), "wool": rgb("d8cfbf"), "clay": rgb("2b2522"),
+      "orange": rgb("c9763a"), "reed": rgb("8f8a4e"), "glow": rgb("ff6a2a")}
+
+
+def sp_dining_table(p, m):    # a long mess-hall table (the syssitia)
+    for i, j in ((-0.4, -0.2), (0.35, -0.2), (-0.4, 0.15), (0.35, 0.15)):
+        p.box(i, i + 0.05, j, j + 0.05, 0, 34, m["dark"])
+    p.box(-0.45, 0.45, -0.25, 0.22, 34, 40, m["wood"])
+    p.box(-0.3, -0.15, -0.05, 0.05, 40, 44, m["clay"])     # a bowl of black broth
+
+
+def sp_chair(p, m):           # a folding stool (diphros) with a sheepskin
+    for a, b in (((-0.12, -0.12), (0.12, 0.12)), ((0.12, -0.12), (-0.12, 0.12))):
+        p.line((a[0], a[1], 0), (b[0], b[1], 26), m["dark"], 4)
+        p.line((b[0], b[1], 0), (a[0], a[1], 26), m["dark"], 4)
+    p.box(-0.15, 0.15, -0.15, 0.15, 26, 30, m["wool"])
+
+
+def sp_throne(p, m):          # a stone seat, high back, the lambda in scarlet
+    p.box(-0.22, 0.22, -0.2, 0.2, 0, 30, m["stone"])
+    p.box(-0.22, 0.22, -0.2, -0.12, 30, 92, m["stone"])
+    a, b, c = p.p(0.0, -0.11, 78), p.p(-0.12, -0.11, 44), p.p(0.12, -0.11, 44)
+    p.d.line([b, a, c], fill=sh(m["scarlet"], 1.0), width=6)
+    p.box(-0.2, 0.2, -0.12, 0.18, 30, 34, m["scarlet"])
+
+
+def sp_bench(p, m):
+    p.box(-0.4, 0.4, -0.12, 0.12, 0, 22, m["stone"])
+    p.box(-0.42, 0.42, -0.14, 0.14, 22, 27, sh(m["stone"], 1.08))
+
+
+def sp_couch(p, m):           # a plain wooden couch with a scarlet blanket
+    p.box(-0.42, 0.42, -0.2, 0.2, 0, 22, m["wood"])
+    p.box(-0.4, 0.4, -0.18, 0.18, 22, 27, m["scarlet"])
+    p.box(-0.42, -0.32, -0.2, 0.2, 22, 40, m["wood"])
+
+
+def sp_bed(p, m):             # reeds on a low frame - Spartans slept on rushes from the Eurotas
+    p.box(-0.42, 0.42, -0.24, 0.24, 0, 12, m["dark"])
+    p.box(-0.4, 0.4, -0.22, 0.22, 12, 17, m["reed"])
+    for k in range(9):
+        j = -0.2 + k * 0.05
+        p.line((-0.38, j, 17.5), (0.38, j, 17.5), sh(m["reed"], 0.75), 1)
+    p.box(-0.38, -0.2, -0.18, 0.18, 17, 21, m["wool"])
+
+
+def sp_tech_desk(p, m):
+    p.box(-0.35, 0.35, -0.18, 0.18, 0, 36, m["iron"])
+    p.box(-0.25, 0.25, -0.16, -0.12, 36, 62, m["dark"])
+    a, b = p.p(-0.2, -0.115, 58), p.p(0.2, -0.115, 40)
+    p.d.rectangle([min(a[0], b[0]), min(a[1], b[1]), max(a[0], b[0]), max(a[1], b[1])], fill=sh(m["glow"], 0.8))
+
+
+def sp_cabinet(p, m):         # a tall wooden cupboard bound in iron
+    p.box(-0.2, 0.2, -0.16, 0.16, 0, 86, m["wood"])
+    for h in (18, 50, 78):
+        p.box(-0.205, 0.205, 0.155, 0.165, h, h + 3, m["iron"], line=False)
+    p.disc(0.0, 0.17, 0.02, 44, m["bronze"])

+encyclopedia entries into data/main_quest.json's "lore" (ids "<empire>_...").
